where Porson wrote καὶ ταξιάρχας χἀκατοντάρχας στρατῷ | ἔταξα [and I appointed taxiarchs and centurions for the army], where nothing prevented ταξιάρχους χἀκατοντάρχους [taxiarchs and centurions] from being written, a form more approved by the ancient Attic writers. On both forms see Thes. vol. 7 p. 1815.
